cast: My Hero Academia: Izuku Midoriya (agent), Eijiro Kirishima, Momo Yaoyorozu and Denki Kaminari (customers)

lines.text: It's 9:42 PM in Chicago, and Izuku tries to call Eijiro.
lines.say: It's nine forty-two P M in Chicago, and Izuku tries to call Eijiro.

lines.text: With the dialer, the server blocks it. Calls go out from 8 AM to 9 PM, their time.
lines.say: With the dialer, the server blocks it. Calls go out from eight A M to nine P M, their time.

lines.text: Each customer gets three attempts in any 24 hours.
lines.say: Each customer gets three attempts in any twenty-four hours.

lines.text: And blocked numbers are never dialed.
lines.say: And blocked numbers are never dialed.

lines.text: It's built to keep your whole floor inside calling-hours rules.
